slides.text: You hit send. Nothing happens for a minute. Did it work?
Your transfer is waiting in a *queue* to be written into the blockchain.
A *confirmation* = your transfer has been included in a block.
Each new block after it is one more *confirmation*. More confirmations = harder to reverse.
Platforms wait for a set number before they treat funds as received. That's the "*pending*" you see.
The wait is the *network*, not the platform. It varies by chain and by how busy it is.
